about: The Workbench icons of the Pacman4Console drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art in art/ is drawn by amiga/icons/draw_art.py (upstream has none). Pacman4Console-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Pacman.info the game's. ReadMe.info is also copied for COPYING.txt. PacmanEdit is a Shell command (it needs a level file named): no icon.
